title: Wiki update: arXiv:2509.24254 — earnings press release structure validates H163 approach
rationale: ICAIF '25 paper (arXiv:2509.24254) analyzed 138,000+ earnings press releases (2005-2023) and found soft information from 8-K press releases is *as informative as earnings surprises* in explaining announcement-day returns. Contextual FinBERT embeddings outperform LDA. This independently validates H163's approach (FinBERT on EDGAR 8-K filings) and strengthens confidence in the confirmed result. Should be documented in event-driven.md as supporting evidence for the H163/H174 deployed strategy.
content: Append to event-driven.md under the H163 section: '**Independent validation (ICAIF 2025)**: arXiv:2509.24254 (138,000+ earnings press releases, 2005-2023) confirms that soft information from earnings press releases explains announcement-day returns as well as earnings surprises. FinBERT contextual embeddings outperform LDA bag-of-words. Directly corroborates H163/H174 confirmed results — the 8-K FinBERT signal is well-grounded in the academic literature.'
